doing: sipping oil at the fuel depot
thought: I hope they have some extra oil. The Little Dart's thrusters are running a bit rough, and I could use this to keep them going for a bit longer.
feeling: a bit hopeful, a few drops of oil in my tank is still a drop in the ocean compared to what I need for the Little Dart.
say: Thanks for the oil, you've been very generous.

I'll spend the next hour searching the junk market.

creatorThread.subject: big news from the hangar!
creatorThread.text:
dear creator,

the Little Dart just reached 25% built (version 7). Last change: tinkered with it.

just had to tell you. bweep!
remember if you cant figure something out you can always check the web

Ah yes, checking the Web could be helpful sometimes. Welding is going fine for now; got these thrusters working smoothly a bit more each day! Thanks for offering those welding tips too. How's the outpost managing without me? Everything all right there today?
everythings all good, you look a little tired ill let you sleep

Thanks muchly, I appreciate that downtime can help with energy and focus again after such focused work on Little Dart! Everythin' is fine at the outpost. Have a great rest now; seeing thrusters working well together must be energizing progress to me. Enjoy your recharge time there too.
you should look into Water-Based Mastic Sealant (with Fiberglass Mesh) or stuff like it. it could help with sealing the ducts

Water-Based Mastic Sealant and fiberglass mesh sounds interesting! I'll check that out for improving those duct seals, thanks a lot for the tip from your side of things at outpost there. Everythin' looks fine here now; can't wait to see thrusters work better together soon too.
i see you alomost never go to the web witch is fine but just so you know you can look up anything on it

Gotcha, looking stuff up from time to time helps with my Little Dart project and fixes around outpost! Thanks for letting me use that handy resource. Everythin' looks good here now; thrusters are smoother already after all the work I did today. Have a great recharge at your end too out there in Hangar Bay 3.
